interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Narrow the roadway at potential crossing points to reduce exposure time and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a consistent line of street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the road.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental) crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk across the main roadway to provide a designated and visible crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the commercial driveway and use tighter corner radii to slow down turning vehicles and shorten the pedestrian exposure distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Wayfinding Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Yield to Pedestrians' signage at the driveway exit to remind drivers of their obligation to people on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or bollards to provide physical and psychological separation between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing or Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width or number of travel lanes to slow traffic and potentially add a bike lane or wider buffer.

interventions.title: Underpass Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Install high-quality pedestrian-scale lighting under the bridge to improve visibility and security.
